contract: Center Incharge and Vertical Lead dashboards link to scoped alert pages. Deadline monitoring includes active project/batch completion and local client visits/QC corrective actions; employee alerts require measured recent attendance/review evidence. Batch sessions are tabular with text and dot status, scoped role data, keyboard-openable viewer/host. Reuse existing console and monitoring tokens with light/dark support.

accessibility.evidence: Accessibility snapshots expose labeled project/status and alert category selects, table headers and session buttons named by batch. Keyboard Enter on focused View session opens offline interface; visible focus outline computed solid. Status includes Live/Not live text as well as dots.

responsive.evidence: Inspected 1440x900 desktop table and 390x844 alert screenshots in dark/light themes. At 390px document width does not overflow; wide session table scrolls within its container. Mobile light alert heading computes rgb(15,23,42), and long deadline context wraps.

loading.reason: The new alert and table data initialize synchronously from mock records/local storage, so no remote data loading stage exists. Existing lazy WebRTC host/viewer has Loading session interface fallback; real media connection states remain outside this rendered verification.

empty.evidence: Selecting Performance without measured recent underperformance yields an empty alert state; no metrics are synthesized. An offline selected batch displays This batch is not live.

error.evidence: Temporarily malformed session registry JSON; table stayed rendered with Not live status, then original registry restored. Audit/live session unit tests cover expired registration and outdated session removal.

partial.evidence: Current mock data contains stale employee attendance and no recorded reviews. Dashboard shows deadline alerts and zero employee follow-ups rather than inferring poor performance. Temporary actual review injection produced employee-specific score alert, then was removed.

success.evidence: Temporary QA registration changed Angul batch to Live while Jharsuguda stayed Not live, with count 1. Removed after verification. Selecting trainer assigned batch opens Start Broadcasting interface with ANG-ELEC-101 metadata; offline viewer and keyboard handoff verified.

permission.evidence: Center alert page displays Angul center only. Vertical page includes assigned Angul/Jharsuguda plus their project deadlines; excludes Kalahandi. Project Lead session table shows Angul only; trainer sees their assigned batch. Existing role-scope tests pass.

limitations: Camera broadcast and cross-device WebRTC playback were not exercised. Registry discovery currently uses same-origin browser storage, not a shared backend. Client wrapper retains existing funding-agency project scope; authenticated client UI was not manually exercised.

renderedEvidence.observation: Vertical Lead batch table with two scoped batches and temporary QA Live/Not live markers. QA registry entry removed after capture.
Center Incharge alert page: compact threshold disclosure, scoped overdue batch deadline, readable summary and mobile navigation.
Light theme mobile alert page: dark heading, sufficient semantic overdue contrast and wrapped text.
